title: Free Bakry--Émery Calculus
summary: We prove a free probabilistic Bakry--Émery criterion for logarithmic Sobolev inequalities and hypercontractivity. Our approach relies on a noncommutative version of the carré du champ operator and its iteration, which we are able to define in the free probability setting. This allows us to formulate a positive curvature condition, which is shown to be sufficient for logarithmic Sobolev inequalities and hypercontractivity in this setting.
